settings.anonymousStatsDesc: Yaak is local-first and does not collect analytics or usage data.
settings.autoDownloadDesc: Download Yaak updates in the background so they are ready to install.
settings.checkNotificationsDesc: Periodically ping Yaak servers to check for relevant notifications.
settings.encryptionDesc: Encrypt workspace secrets and sensitive values at rest.
settings.generalDesc: Configure general settings for update behavior and more.
settings.httpVersionDesc: Force HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 for servers that don't negotiate the version correctly.
settings.messageSizeLimitDesc: Maximum gRPC or WebSocket message size in MB. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.promptFeedbackDesc: Show rare one-time prompts asking how new features are working.
settings.requestTimeoutDesc: Maximum request duration in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.sendCookiesDesc: Attach matching cookies from the active cookie jar to outgoing requests.
settings.storeCookiesDesc: Save cookies from Set-Cookie response headers to the active cookie jar.
settings.syncDirDesc: Sync data to a folder for backup and Git integration.
settings.title: Settings
settings.updateBehaviorDesc: Choose whether updates are installed automatically or manually.
settings.updateChannelDesc: Choose whether Yaak should use stable releases or beta releases.
settings.validateTlsDesc: When disabled, skip validation of server certificates.
